exposure: Care plan (active care vs comfort care)
cohort: The study included mother-infant dyads (single or twin infants with no known congenital anomalies) delivered between 23 0/7 and 24 6/7 weeks gestational age from January 2012 to December 2016.
finding: Two-thirds (4/6) of families who initially opted for comfort care later changed their decision to active care, resulting in a missed opportunity for antenatal steroids.
